description: This file contains utility functions for handling metric and fixed value configurations in a charting context, including type guards, extraction, and label retrieval.

methods.name: isMetricValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is configured as a metric (vs fixed value).

methods.name: isFixedValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is configured as a fixed value (vs metric).

methods.name: extractMetricKey
methods.description: Extracts the metric key from a metric value object, handling label, sqlExpression, and value properties.

methods.name: getMetricLabelFromValue
methods.description: Gets the metric label from a fixed/metric form value, returning undefined for fixed values.

methods.name: getFixedValue
methods.description: Gets the fixed value from a fixed/metric form value, returning undefined for metrics.
